Internal: the word missing in a map, found

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_missing_token_rules.Rd

The rules whose new value is the word missing, whether the NA rule is one, and the label labels = "missing=..." gives it; a label for the word with no rule using it stops (S355: the token quoted, so it cannot read as an adjective). jrecode() and jencode() each held this block (Session 386, the twin build).

Usage

.jst_missing_token_rules(parsed_map, parsed_labels, example)

Arguments

parsed_map, parsed_labels

The parsed map and labels.

example

Character(1): the stop's example rule.

Value

list(tok_rule_idx, tok_in_na, has_missing_token, tok_missing_label).
